name: sentinelone-mcp
description: Every SentinelOne v2.1 management endpoint, plus an offline SQLite store and cross-entity analytics — fleet health, threat triage, blast radius, drift — that no console view offers.

sentinelone_api_token.title: SENTINELONE_API_TOKEN
sentinelone_api_token.description: Sets SENTINELONE_API_TOKEN for the SentinelOne MCP server.

sentinelone_base_url.title: SentinelOne console API base URL
sentinelone_base_url.description: Base URL of your SentinelOne management console API, including the version path, e.g. https://usea1-partners.sentinelone.net/web/api/v2.1. The shipped default points at an example host.

sentinelone_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
sentinelone_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any non-GET execute call. Preset to 1; clear it only when you want the agent to run the tools this switch hides.

sentinelone_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
sentinelone_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API, the response cache is off, and sync refuses to run. Leave blank to keep the local store.

sentinelone_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
sentinelone_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on SentinelOne requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

sentinelone_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
sentinelone_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile
printing_press_client_profile.description: Binds this MCP server to one tenant-gated client profile, so every call answers for that customer. Leave blank to use the profile configured as default_client_profile.
